subject: [PATCH v8 17/30] mm: handle soft-dirty and uffd-wp on PMD swap entries

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch updates the Linux kernel to correctly handle soft-dirty and uffd-wp flags on PMD swap entries, ensuring that these flags are properly updated during page table operations. The changes affect several functions in fs/proc/task_mmu.c and mm/huge_memory.c, where the code now checks for both migration and swap entries when updating these flags. This patch addresses a problem where clearing soft-dirty would skip swapped-out THPs, UFFDIO_WRITEPROTECT would not arm it, and mremap would not mark the destination correctly.
